title: Touhou Project (Series) - The Icon of Extermination ☯️ ~ Reimu Hakurei Medley (Sunset-mix)
description:
❝ 𝐄𝐡, 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫. 𝐈𝐟 𝐈 𝐮𝐬𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐘𝐢𝐧-𝐘𝐚𝐧𝐠 𝐨𝐫𝐛 𝐰𝐞𝐥𝐥 𝐞𝐧𝐨𝐮𝐠𝐡, 𝐢𝐭'𝐥𝐥 𝐚𝐥𝐥 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐤 𝐨𝐮𝐭, 𝐫𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭? ❞
ㅤ- Reimu Hakurei, Touhou Reiiden ~ Highly Responsive to Prayers (1995)



Did a medley arrangement of a good chunk of Reimu Hakurei's Theme songs from the Touhou Project series
(ft. Sunset Heights Act 1 from Sonic X Shadow Generations)
because why the hell not. Had this idea thought up of for a while, and given how much I love mashing stuff together, I thought another dedicated Touhou medley-mix for Reimu (the last one I did was the Mega Man Stage Select Medley) would be sick given she is after all, little miss Touhou Project. This is easily one of my most ambitious mixes in a long time if not ever (currently), and it was super duper fun to do.

Important:
ㅤ♠ "Bonus End," P-Switch, Yoshi SFX, & Thunder SFX are disabled.
ㅤ♠ Death sound is gonna sound weird (@0 replaces @9 to save on space).

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. B Minor w/ Slight Detune (Remix Pitch)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. B Minor (Custom Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ3. A# Minor (Fuumaroku Pitch)
ㅤ4. A Minor (Suimusou Pitch)
ㅤ5. C Minor (Hisoutensoku Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Original Echo Delay, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (OG Echo)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. No Echo Delay (NO Echo)ㅤ[turned on by default]
